purpose: Clarify that the five Stage 1B programs serve different scientific roles - relevant for the eventual paper's structure.

GalaxyPPG.role_description: Independent replication - same scientific question (wrist IMU value for HR) as PPG-DaLiA, different dataset/device/subject family.

HMC.role_description: Independent replication - same scientific question (EOG value for sleep staging) as Sleep-EDF, different institution/population/hardware.

QDE_V2.role_description: New sensor-value experiment on an existing dataset family already held by this project (bilateral leg impedance, not a new dataset).

LBNP.role_description: New sensor-value experiment (thoracic EIS value for LBNP-stage) AND a new independent dataset family simultaneously - a novel physiological-challenge paradigm not previously in this project.

ds003838.role_description: New target/domain - cognitive/working-memory load, not cardiovascular or sleep, using a new EEG montage and a spatial-coverage-minimalism question distinct from the modality-fusion questions the other four programs ask.
